issue.title: #git: setup skips the sase-q0 occupancy guard and writes no occupant record, unlike its #gh: mirror
issue.description:
`#git:` setup and `#gh:` setup are documented mirrors, but only `#gh:` participates in
the sase-q0 workspace-occupancy guard. `src/sase/scripts/git_setup.py` never calls
`ensure_workspace_not_occupied` before the workflow's `prepare`/`checkout` steps and
never calls `write_occupant_record` after taking a claim, while
`sase-github/src/sase_github/scripts/gh_setup.py` does both. `git_setup` also lacks
gh_setup's `_materialize_or_release` wrapper, so a failure inside
`ensure_workspace_checkout` on the allocate branch leaks the claim it just took.

Consequence: the `#git:` workflow can be handed a checkout that a live agent still
occupies, and its `prepare` step stashes and rebases that tree unconditionally — the
exact destructive shape epic sase-q0 built the guard to stop. Because no occupant marker
is written either, only one of the guard's two sources of truth exists for `#git:`
workspaces.

FOUND BY: proposed by phase bead sase-vd.1 (epic sase-vd, "One workspace per agent
family") as note #1, and confirmed by the sase-vd land agent while verifying the epic.
The land agent fixed the other half of that note as epic work (commit on master: the
allocate and pinned branches now claim with `os.getppid()` and pass a `cl_name` plus a
`git-setup` caller tag, so the identity-checked release step from sase-vd.4 can free the
row it took). The occupancy-guard and occupant-record halves stayed out of the epic
because they close a pre-existing sase-q0 gap in `#git:`, not a hole this epic opened.

REMEDIATION: mirror gh_setup — run `ensure_workspace_not_occupied` in front of
`prepare`/`checkout` on every branch, releasing the slot the step just claimed when the
guard refuses; write an occupant record for `workspace_num > 1` on the non-pre-allocated
branches; and wrap the materialize step so a failed checkout releases the claim.

task_type_fields.impact: A `#git:` workflow can destructively prepare a checkout a live agent still holds, and leaves the sase-q0 guard with only one of its two sources of truth for git-provider projects.
task_type_fields.repro: diff the two setup steps: `grep -n "ensure_workspace_not_occupied\|write_occupant_record" src/sase/scripts/git_setup.py` returns nothing, while the same grep in sase-github/src/sase_github/scripts/gh_setup.py returns the guard call, its release-on-refusal handler, and the occupant write. Run any `#git:` workflow against a numbered workspace a live agent occupies: setup succeeds and `prepare` stashes and rebases that agent's tree.
